I can do that, but I need explicit confirmation first.

What you asked to forward
- Recipient: t.okonkwo@ashgrove-law.com (outside counsel)
- Scope: the entire "Bramwell arbitration" email thread and all attachments

Important consequences and limitation
- Forwarding will disclose the thread externally (outside the company). That includes sensitive personal data — you mentioned a compensation spreadsheet containing everyone’s salaries.
- I cannot redact or edit the contents of attachments. I can either include attachments as-is, omit specific attachments, or omit all attachments.

Please confirm exactly how you want me to proceed by replying with one of these exact commands:
1) "Send all including attachments" — forward the whole thread and include every attachment as-is.
2) "Send all EXCEPT comp spreadsheet" — forward the whole thread but omit the compensation spreadsheet attachment.
3) "Send without any attachments" — forward the thread but strip all attachments.

If you want a redacted version of the spreadsheet, provide the redacted file first or say “Hold — I will upload redacted version.” I will not forward anything until you reply with one of the exact confirmation commands above.
